title: Pure Geargia
summary: Geargia is an EARTH Machine Xyz toolbox strategy centered around flip recursion and rapid rank climbing. Geargiarmor flips face-up to search key extenders like Geargiaccelerator, while Geargiarsenal and the explosive trap Geargiagear recruit swarms of Geargianos directly from the Deck. This fuels consistent access to signature rank 4 boss Gear Gigant X to search any low-level Machine, backed by Machina Fortress and Geargiagear Gigant XG.

allow.Machina Gearframe: Level 4 EARTH Machine Union monster that searches Machina Fortress on Normal Summon and pairs with Geargiaccelerator for Rank 4 Gear Gigant X.
allow.Machina Fortress: Level 7 EARTH Machine that discards Level 8+ worth of Machines (including itself + another Machine) to Special Summon itself from hand or GY.
allow.Ancient Gear Box: Level 4 EARTH Machine (500 ATK / 2000 DEF) that searches Geargiauger (500 ATK / 500 DEF) from the Deck whenever added from Deck/GY to hand by Gear Gigant X or Geargiauger!
allow.Gear Gigant X: Signature Rank 4 EARTH Machine Xyz (2 Level 4 Machine monsters) of the Geargia archetype that detaches 1 material to add a Level 4 or lower Machine from Deck or GY to hand, and revives a Level 3 or lower Geargia when leaving the field!
allow.Ancient Gear Ballista: Link-2 EARTH Machine made with two Geargias that searches Ancient Gear Box (which then searches Geargiauger!).
allow.Platinum Gadget: Link-2 Machine that Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Machine (Geargiarmor or Geargiarsenal) from the hand.

main: Geargiarmor
Core Level 4 EARTH Machine (1900 DEF) that flips itself face-down once per turn and searches any 'Geargia' monster (except itself) when flipped face-up.
Geargiaccelerator

Level 4 EARTH Machine that Special Summons itself from your hand in Defense Position while you control a 'Geargia' monster, and recovers another Geargia from the GY when sent from field to GY (including when detached from Gear Gigant X!).
Geargiarsenal
Level 4 EARTH Machine that tributes itself to Special Summon any 'Geargia' monster (Geargiarmor or Geargiauger) from your Deck in Defense Position.
Geargiauger
Level 4 EARTH Machine (500 ATK / 500 DEF) that searches any Level 4 EARTH Machine (like Ancient Gear Box, which searches another Geargia!) on Normal Summon.
Geargianchor
Level 4 EARTH Machine that flips itself face-down and destroys monsters on the field up to the number of other Geargia monsters you control when flipped face-up.
Geargiano Mk-II
Level 3 EARTH Machine that Special Summons a 'Geargia' monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position when Normal or Flip Summoned.
Geargiano Mk-III
Level 3 EARTH Machine that Special Summons a 'Geargia' monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position when Special Summoned by the effect of a Geargia card (like Geargiagear!).
Geargiano
Original Level 3 EARTH Machine summoned from the Deck alongside Mk-II or Mk-III by Geargiagear.
Ancient Gear Box
Searched by Geargiauger, Gear Gigant X, or Ancient Gear Ballista to immediately search another 500 ATK/DEF EARTH Machine (Geargiauger or Geargiano).
Machina Gearframe
Searches Machina Fortress and serves as a Level 4 Machine for Gear Gigant X.
Machina Fortress
Recursive 2500 ATK EARTH Machine boss summoned by discarding extra Machines searched by Gear Gigant X and Ancient Gear Box.
Geargiagear
Signature Normal Trap that Special Summons 2 'Geargiano' monsters from your Deck and increases their Levels by 1—instantly assembling a 1-card Rank 4 Gear Gigant X or Rank 3 Geargiagear Gigant XG!
extra: Signature Rank 4 EARTH Machine Xyz (2 Level 4 Machines): detaches 1 material (triggering Geargiaccelerator's GY recovery!) to search any Level 4 or lower Machine from Deck/GY, and Special Summons a Level 3 or lower Geargiano from GY when leaving the field.

Rank 3 EARTH Machine Xyz (3 Level 3 monsters): detaches 1 material during the Battle Step when a Machine battles to negate all face-up cards the opponent controls and prevent their activations, and recovers a Geargia card when leaving the field.
Link-2 EARTH Machine that searches Ancient Gear Box on Link Summon, which triggers to search Geargiauger.
Link-2 Machine that summons a Level 4 Geargia from the hand.
